user.title: InPost Login
user.description:
1. Open the [InPost login page]({login_url}) in your browser and sign in (phone number, SMS code, captcha and email confirmation).
2. After a successful login your browser is redirected to a `https://account.inpost-group.com/callback?code=...` page (it may look blank or show an error - that is fine).
3. Copy the full address from your browser's address bar and paste it below.
